meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 DeltaChat 收发邮件消息，支持端到端加密。用户需先通过邀请链接或二维码添加机器人为联系人。
howto.when: 当用户通过 DeltaChat 应用向机器人发送消息时触发。首次消息后需运行 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 将聊天连接到智能体。

say.text: 帮我设置 DeltaChat 频道
运行 /init-first-agent 连接我的 DeltaChat 聊天
say.note: 创建智能体并绑定聊天
将现有聊天连接到智能体组

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive email-based messages via DeltaChat with end-to-end encryption. Users must first add the bot as a contact using an invite link or QR code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a message to the bot via the DeltaChat app. After the first message, run /init-first-agent or /manage-channels to connect the chat to an agent.

say_en.text: Help me set up the DeltaChat channel
Run /init-first-agent to connect my DeltaChat chat
say_en.note: Creates an agent and wires the chat
Connects an existing chat to an agent group
